knowledge:
- key_parameters: filter.type=Type of filtering for low-quality genomic regions (e.g., "raw") ;; filter.value=Minimum read count threshold for filtering ;; samplePassfilter=Minimum number of samples that must pass the filter ;; group1=Reference time point for differential analysis ;; group2=Comparison time points for differential analysis ;; top.sig=Logical indicating whether to extract only significant differential events (log2FC > 2 or < -2, adjusted p-value < 0.05) ;; value=Type of values to use for clustering, either "FC" (fold change) or "expression" (normalized read counts) ;; norm.method=Normalization method, such as "rpkm" ;; filter=Logical indicating whether to filter out genomic regions with no significant changes between any two time points ;; algo=Clustering algorithm, e.g., "cm" for fuzzy c-means, or hard clustering ("hierarchical", "pam", "kmeans") ;; k=Number of clusters ;; standardize=Logical indicating whether to perform z-score transformation on the data before clustering
- alternatives: edgeR=Used internally for negative binomial generalized linear models (GLM) in differential analysis ;; Mfuzz=Alternative soft clustering package referenced for time-course data analysis
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing sequencing data (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq) collected across multiple sequential time points to identify differentially expressed/accessible regions and group them into temporal patterns.
- pitfalls: For epigenomic data (ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq), genomic regions are not pre-defined and vary by condition; failing to merge overlapping regions into a reference set using peakreference will prevent proper downstream differential analysis. Absolute values of different time series can introduce noise in clustering; failing to set standardize = TRUE in timeclust might group regions by absolute expression levels rather than temporal patterns.

workflows.name: time_course_sequencing_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential analysis and temporal pattern clustering on time-course sequencing data (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, or ChIP-seq).
input: experiment_design.txt (sample metadata and optionally BAM file paths)
genomic_intervals.bed (reference genomic regions or peak intervals)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate reference genomic regions from peak files (optional) ;; 2. Create a TCA object ;; 3. Count reads from BAM files (optional) ;; 4. Perform differential analysis ;; 5. Extract differential analysis results ;; 6. Construct a time course table ;; 7. Perform temporal clustering ;; 8. Visualize temporal patterns
workflows.code:
library(TCseq)
dir <- dir.peaks
gf <- peakreference(dir = dir, pattern = "narrowpeaks")
data("genomicIntervals")
data("experiment_BAMfile")
tca <- TCA(design = experiment_BAMfile, genomicFeature = genomicIntervals)
tca <- countReads(tca, dir = dir.BAM)
data("experiment")
data("countsTable")
tca <- TCA(design = experiment, genomicFeature = genomicIntervals, counts = countsTable)
counts(tca) <- countsTable
suppressWarnings(library(SummarizedExperiment))
se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(counts = countsTable), colData = experiment)
tca <- TCAFromSummarizedExperiment(se = se, genomicFeature = genomicIntervals)
tca <- DBanalysis(tca)
tca <- DBanalysis(tca, filter.type = "raw", filter.value = 10, samplePassfilter = 2)
DBres <- DBresult(tca, group1 = "0h", group2 = c("24h","40h","72h"))
DBres.sig <- DBresult(tca, group1 = "0h", group2 = c("24h","40h","72h"), top.sig = TRUE)
tca <- timecourseTable(tca, value = "FC", control.group = "0h", norm.method = "rpkm", filter = TRUE)
tca <- timecourseTable(tca, value = "expression", norm.method = "rpkm", filter = TRUE)
t <- tcTable(tca)
tca <- timeclust(tca, algo = "cm", k = 6, standardize = TRUE)
p <- timeclustplot(tca, value = "z-score(PRKM)", cols = 3)
print(p[[1]])
